description: This file defines the ContentTypesSitemapSourceBuilder class, which builds sitemap URLs for content types in OrchardCore CMS, including metadata and URL generation logic.

classes.name: ContentTypesSitemapSourceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for generating sitemap URLs for content types, including metadata and URL population.

methods.name: BuildSourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds the sitemap source by querying content items and adding URL elements.

methods.name: BuildUrlsetMetadataAsync
methods.description: Builds metadata for each URL element, including URL, last modified date, change frequency, and priority.

methods.name: BuildExtendedMetadataAsync
methods.description: Applies extended metadata providers to enrich URL metadata.

methods.name: BuildUrlAsync
methods.description: Generates the URL for a content item, considering exclusion and routing.

methods.name: PopulateChangeFrequencyPriority
methods.description: Sets the change frequency and priority elements for a URL based on content metadata and source settings.

methods.name: PopulateLastMod
methods.description: Adds last modified date to URL element if available.
